text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I brought an injured Durandal
to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There is no need for concern.
It is only a slight pain.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-dono.
Could you at least allow me
to do my daily routine training?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Daily discipline is vital for swordplay.
If you neglect your devotion,
your body will forget the movements ingrained within it.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Running is the same.
I do not wish to dull this explosive power forged through training by resting.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Please, I entrust this to you
to maintain the "Holy Sword's" sharpness.
choice_data_list: Training can wait until your injury is fully healed.
If it won't make you overdo it...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking a short break won't dull her instantaneous acceleration.
And that's because—
choice_data_list: Your body remembers, so you'll get your feel back in no time

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono...!
What deeply honoring words...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
In that case, I will focus entirely on my recovery.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Now, let us head to the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Durandal began with a lighter routine, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...How careless of me. To misjudge her condition like that...!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry.
I shall rest for a little while longer...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal's injury has worsened.
It seems like it will take some time for her to fully recover..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, when Durandal tried starting with a light routine...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Phew...
There don't seem to be any issues.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
With this,
the Holy Sword's edge will surely not dull.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal went through her daily routine at a reasonable pace,
aiming for her comeback."
